name: Smart Modal – build popups that appear exactly when you want
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Highlight your most important content in a popup visitors can’t miss – build modals right inside the Gutenberg editor.

Why Smart Modal?

Smart Modal makes it easy to create stunning and engaging popups to display titles, content, or links. Built specifically for Gutenberg, it integrates smoothly with the block editor and gives you full flexibility in design and usage – add the block, configure it in the sidebar, and your modal is ready.

It’s an ideal tool for highlighting unique content, quickly sharing links, and increasing user engagement. Thanks to its user-friendly interface and easy setup process, users of every skill level – from beginners to experienced developers – can build modals in minutes.

Free Features

  • Effortless Integration: Add modals directly from the Gutenberg editor.
  • Customizable Settings: Modify modal appearance and behavior through the block settings sidebar.
  • Responsive Design: Your modals look great on all devices.
  • Unlimited Use: Reuse the block as many times as needed on your website.

How to Use

  1. Install the Smart Modal plugin from the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Add the Smart Modal block from the block category called “widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  3. Change the block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.
  4. Publish – your popup is live!

Use Cases

  • Announcements: Put time-sensitive news or offers in front of visitors.
  • Content Highlights: Showcase unique content without cluttering the page.
  • Link Sharing: Present important links in an attention-grabbing popup.
  • Engagement: Add interactive moments that keep visitors on the page.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Smart Modal”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the Smart Modal block to any post or page in the Gutenberg editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Smart Modal plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New, click Upload Plugin, choose the smart-modal.zip file, and click Install Now.
  3. Or upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is Smart Modal free?

Yes, Smart Modal is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change the block settings?

Yes, you can change the modal’s appearance and behavior from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

What can I display inside a modal?

You can display titles, content, or links – ideal for highlighting unique content and increasing engagement.

Are the modals mobile-friendly?

Yes, the modals are fully responsive and look great on all devices.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block an unlimited number of times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
